lesson_body: Welcome back! Today on Day 3, we are learning about geometric shapes, focusing on the Circle. A circle is a perfectly round shape with no straight sides and no corners. You can find circles all over your house, like the face of a clock, a round coin, or the wheels on a bicycle.
interactive_assignment: Use a round plastic cup or a coin to trace three perfect circles onto a sheet of paper. Color the inside of each circle using a different colored crayon.
daily_assessment: Look at a standard clock face. Write down what shape the outer frame represents based on today's geometry rules.
